item.name: Runner
item.activation: Select Runner as the Beast's power before entering the map, then activate it through the in-game Beast power control.
item.effect: Provides a large speed boost and changes jumping, hitstun, and hammer cooldown behavior while active.
item.survivorResponse: The Beast cannot jump while Runner is active.
item.selectionNote: Runner is assigned when the Beast does not choose another power.
item.cardSummary: A mobility-focused Beast power that helps close distance while removing the Beast's ability to jump during use.

item.name: Stalker
item.activation: Select Stalker as the Beast's power before entering the map, then activate it through the in-game Beast power control.
item.effect: Suppresses the Beast's heartbeat and footstep sounds and gemstone glow; it also changes jump and hitstun behavior and opens doors faster while active.
item.survivorResponse: The Beast's heartbeat, footsteps, and gemstone glow are suppressed, reducing the usual warning signals.
item.selectionNote: Stalker is one of the released powers the Beast can choose before entering the map.
item.cardSummary: A stealth-focused Beast power that hides familiar warning signals and changes movement penalties during a chase.

item.name: Seer
item.activation: Select Seer as the Beast's power before entering the map, then activate it through the in-game Beast power control.
item.effect: Warns Survivors to hide, then reveals non-hidden Survivors with an icon; seeing a Survivor directly can give the Beast a speed benefit.
item.survivorResponse: Survivors can hide in supported hiding spots; hidden Survivors are not revealed by the standard Seer reveal.
item.selectionNote: Seer is one of the released powers the Beast can choose before entering the map.
item.cardSummary: A tracking-focused Beast power that pressures Survivors to hide before revealing those who remain exposed.
